title: Actions related to transmission of RemoteUEInformationSidelink message

entities.name: RemoteUEInformationSidelink message
entities.description: Message transmitted by L2 U2N Remote UE containing sidelink information including requested SIBs and paging identity.

entities.name: sl-Requested-SI-List
entities.description: Information element indicating the requested SIB(s) when UE has not stored valid versions.

entities.name: sl-PagingIdentity-RemoteUE
entities.description: Information element containing paging identity (ng-5G-S-TMSI and/or fullI-RNTI) for the remote UE.

entities.name: sl-PagingCycle-RemoteUE
entities.description: Information element containing UE specific DRX cycle configuration for paging.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE state
entities.description: RRC state where UE is idle and not actively connected.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE state
entities.description: RRC state where UE is inactive but maintains some connection context.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED state
entities.description: RRC state where UE is actively connected to the network.

entities.name: UE has not stored valid SIB version
entities.description: Condition where UE lacks valid stored versions of required System Information Blocks.

entities.name: Entering RRC_CONNECTED state
entities.description: Condition triggered when UE transitions to RRC_CONNECTED state.

entities.name: Information Element release
entities.description: Property of setting information elements to release value when entering connected state.

relations.description: RemoteUEInformationSidelink message contains sl-Requested-SI-List IE when UE lacks valid SIBs.
RemoteUEInformationSidelink message contains sl-PagingIdentity-RemoteUE IE for paging identity.
RemoteUEInformationSidelink message contains sl-PagingCycle-RemoteUE IE for DRX cycle configuration.
Condition of no valid SIB stored guards the inclusion of sl-Requested-SI-List IE.
RRC_IDLE state requires inclusion of ng-5G-S-TMSI in sl-PagingIdentity-RemoteUE.
RRC_INACTIVE state requires inclusion of ng-5G-S-TMSI and fullI-RNTI in sl-PagingIdentity-RemoteUE.
Entering RRC_CONNECTED state establishes the property of releasing sl-Requested-SI-List and sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE.
IE release property guards the setting of sl-Requested-SI-List to release value.
IE release property guards the setting of sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE to release value.
